rites.name: Oraria
rites.text: Oraria is the concept of resonant origin in Ryamiel, the sounding that drew the first roots of the world together during the Singing. Where her tone holds, matter gathers into lasting form, and where it breaks, the nascent roots scatter.

rites.name: Asheistith
rites.text: Asheistith is the sleeping principle of the Weave, a concept that the makers of Ryamiel planted during the Seeding so that quiet powers could root beneath the world's surface. It is less a being than a standing pattern of restraint, felt only as a faint hum in the ground and in the stillness of old stones.

rites.name: Ukasalira
rites.text: Ukasalira is the quiet concept of the Weave as the makers sow it into Ryamiel's Arcane Realm during the Seeding. It is less a force than a pattern waiting to wake, holding the sleeping powers that later eras will grow into.

rites.name: Malleranum
rites.text: Malleranum is the concept of a sleeping arcane current that the makers of Ryamiel wove into the land during the Seeding, long before the Holy Age of flame and temples. It is said to answer only to those who speak in the old orders' chants, and it lies dormant beneath every shrine.

rites.name: Miiniel
rites.text: Miiniel is a concept of Ryamiel, the thread of unbound intent that ran through the Fall and the Sundering, when worlds cracked and the Pact was sworn over their shards. It is remembered as the will that refused to let the broken pieces forget one another.

rites.name: Orostia
rites.text: Orostia is the concept of the Pact sworn in the Ryamiel Fall, when the Sundering broke the old worlds into Shards. It is remembered as the oath that bound the broken fragments into a single lattice of obligation. Its power lies in binding, not in destruction.

rites.name: Xaavsis
rites.text: Xaavsis is the concept of binding, the thread that held shattered worlds to their meaning during the Fall of Ryamiel. In the Sundering it was said to have stitched the Shards together with its own sworn word, becoming the first witness of the Pact.

rites.name: Drureld
rites.text: Drureld is the concept of the Walled Age in Ryamiel, the centuries when people raised holding walls and built orders and churches to keep the sea and the dark at bay. It came to define the period of first crossings, when landfall broke the old bonds that had held each settlement together. Its meaning rests on the balance between protection and the need to open a gate.

rites.name: Vorugaikar
rites.text: Vorugaikar is a concept woven through Ryamiel's Three Futures, a notion of a branching ending that the Library shelves beside every other outcome. It surfaces in the Age of Sundering, when landfall tore old bonds apart and left the concept to be argued over by those who remembered it.
